item.title: 2017 Land Rover Range Rover SVAutobiography LWB
item.description: This 2017 Land Rover Range Rover SVAutobiography LWB was specified in Indus Silver Metallic and black over Ebony and Lunar leather. The truck has 57k miles, and it has spent most of its time in California, Montana, Arizona, Nevada, and Montana. item.title: 26k-Mile 2016 Mercedes-Benz E400 Sedan 4MATIC
item.description: This 2016 Mercedes-Benz E400 4MATIC sedan has been registered to one owner and has 26k miles. The car is powered by a twin-turbocharged 3.0-liter V6 that drives all four wheels through a seven-speed automatic transmission and is finished in black over black leather. Equipment includes a sunroof, 18" AMG split-spoke alloy wheels, a rearview camera, navigation, heated and ventilated power-adjustable front seats, a Harman Kardon sound system, Keyless Go, and dual-zone automatic climate control. item.title: 2002 Jeep Wrangler Sahara 5-Speed
item.description: This 2002 Jeep Wrangler Sahara was registered in Nevada and California before it was acquired by the seller on BaT in January 2023, and it has 58k miles. item.title: 1994 Lamborghini Diablo SE30
item.description: This 1994 Lamborghini Diablo is #77 of 150 SE30 examples produced to commemorate the marque’s 30th anniversary.
